text: FIE073 will deliver a written plan covering functional and technical design, staffing, timeframe, budget, and market plan by two weeks.
A problem was raised indicating scope/goal misalignment between project understanding and management intent.
UI will determine the functional design as the immediate next step, and ID(FIE073) will identify additional contributors for the plan.
The group decided to focus the project on designing a remote control for television and will start with that remote control as the first product.
The project manager will send a copy of the slides to all attendees at the conclusion of the meeting.
